initialExam.title: ISRO Scientist/Engineer 2026
initialExam.description: ISRO recruits Scientists and Engineers for space research, satellite development, and rocket propulsion projects.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech with First Class in relevant discipline
initialExam.syllabus: Domain-specific engineering subjects. Interview: technical + HR.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Interview → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: SC → SD → SE → SF → SG → Distinguished Scientist.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit apply.isro.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Professional update allowance, Campus housing
